name: AutoClicker
description: Executes a validated UI tap request through Android AccessibilityService.
permissions: Android Accessibility Service must be enabled
inputs: ClickRequest: bounded physical pixel coordinates, actionId, and expectedPackage.
outputs: ClickResult with accepted/rejected state, status, detail, and coordinates.
limits: Coordinates must be within current real display bounds; the caller validates target package and intent.
tests: ClickRequest/ClickResult and screen-bounds unit tests are pending; manual device verification is required.
limitations: A completed Android gesture does not prove that the target application processed the tap.
The host project is responsible for confirming the active package and intended target before requesting a tap.
